G_B2_precondition_engine.task: Validate execution prerequisites with blocking vs warning classification
key_features: evaluatePreconditions() returns PreconditionCheckResult with blocking_failures and warnings arrays
canExecute() blocks if any blocking precondition fails
getExecutionBlockReason() provides formatted operator-readable reason
Separates blocking failures from non-critical warnings
tests: should pass when all preconditions satisfied
should block when blocking precondition fails
should separate blocking vs warning conditions

G_B3_scope_enforcement_engine.task: Validate recommendation applicability to operational context
key_features: validateScope() checks all 5 dimensions independently
out_of_scope_reasons array with detailed mismatch explanations
confidence_impact negative adjustment (-100 to 0) for each mismatch
shouldBlockForScopeMismatch() triggers execution block if impact < -50
Rejects SaaS guidance for restaurants, enterprise guidance for SMBs, all geography mismatches
tests: should reject SaaS guidance applied to restaurant
should reject enterprise guidance applied to startup

key_features: arbitrateConstraintConflict() deterministically suppresses lower-priority recommendation
For same-priority conflicts, uses lexicographic (alphabetical) tie-breaking on recommendation IDs
CONSTRAINT_PRECEDENCE numeric ranking prevents oscillating recommendations
isSuppressed() checks if recommendation is suppressed due to conflicts
getSuppressionReason() provides formatted reason for operator visibility
tests: should suppress growth when cashflow is prioritized

G_B5_recommendation_change_ledger.task: Implement append-only immutable change history for recommendations
key_features: createChangeEvent() creates immutable event with auto-generated event_id and timestamp
appendEvent() returns new ledger, prevents mutation of historical entries
preventMutation() enforces no historical modification (returns false if event exists)
replayLedger() reconstructs current state from all events with change_count and earliest/latest timestamps
generateExplainabilityTimeline() provides operator-readable formatted timeline of all changes
tests: should prevent mutation of historical events
should replay ledger to reconstruct state
